claims.claim: The versioned shared registry covers all twelve required families with exact selector schemas, deterministic identities, bounded serialization and strict malformed/substituted-field rejection.
Selector-only envelope validation excludes action, verdict, correction, successor, execution-profile, command and private browser fields; synthetic rejection cases cover these exclusions.
RESULT and FAILURE retain their existing identities and canonical freshness checks while mapping to the corresponding generic attention families.
Shared projection handles exact carrier, review-ingress and correction-authoring rejection selectors and canonical non-PASS review follow-up. PASS ingress emits no correction attention.
Dispatch and pre-AIOS failure projections use bounded source observations and Operational Receipt v2, preserve run_created=false, and exclude the ordinary-progress matrix.

Publication projections bind canonical review lineage and attempt evidence; success produces planning attention without roadmap writes. Conflict projections bind prepared subjects and exact predecessor facts.

Generic intake uses the existing durable lane path, preserving freshness barriers, canonical resolution, lane isolation, generation guards, one-flight ordering, ambiguity holds and duplicate-preserving compaction.
Recovery requires an existing unresolved original identity, rejects recursive recovery, operates on the original record and retains it when source evidence is unknown.

Synthetic regression cases cover progress exclusions, privacy, canonical attribution, source conflicts and recovery. Local wake workflows use read permissions without self-dispatch or downstream activation.
The committed changes affect only authorized files and include a bounded Human conformance procedure without claiming live conformance, planning reconciliation or H4B resume.
